name: Field error
summary: The accessible field / validation error every input points aria-describedby at — the a11y FieldError (forms) and FieldErrorDisplay (respondent renderers) in one element.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-field-error> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. It is the only error node a field should describe itself with: a stable id (minted if you give none) for aria-describedby, danger text bound to --aha-text-negative, and NOTHING rendered while `message` is empty. `variant="respondent"` is the FieldErrorDisplay contract for respondent element renderers — role="alert" + aria-live="assertive", so the error is announced the moment it appears. The message is mirrored into the host's light DOM so aria-describedby and the alert read it directly. The input still owns its half of the wiring: aria-invalid + aria-describedby="<error id>".
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. Pass the TRANSLATED string as `message`; the DS does not own i18n keys. The input owns its half of the wiring: aria-invalid + aria-describedby="<error id>". A DS <aha-input> does both for you — status="error" sets aria-invalid and it forwards its aria-describedby to the inner field.

spec.label: Empty
spec.value: message empty or absent → host hidden (renders nothing)

spec.label: Form variant (default)
spec.value: a11y FieldError — stable id for aria-describedby, no live role

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: fades + slides 4px in on --aha-motion-mid / --aha-ease-out; off under prefers-reduced-motion

props.name: message
props.desc: The (translated) error text. Empty hides the element.

props.name: variant
props.desc: form = a11y FieldError (AntD / form contexts); respondent = FieldErrorDisplay (role=alert, assertive)

props.name: id
props.desc: Target for the input's aria-describedby; minted as aha-field-error-N when absent

whenToUse.when: one field failed validation and the user must fix it before continuing
inside a respondent element renderer (audience answer inputs)
the problem is page- or form-level, not tied to one field
never for a validation error — it disappears before it can be fixed

opinion.note: Never hand-roll a red <span> under an input: it has no id to describe the field, no alert semantics and drifts off the token. Say what is wrong and how to fix it ("Enter an email address, like name@example.com"), not just "Invalid". Colour is never the only signal — the text is the error. Replaces the aha-design plugin's aha-design-shared-components registry entry (SHARED-01, SHARED-02).
opinion.dsv3: Derived — the DS V3 Form item carries the error explain under the control; size and colour come from the token layer (text-negative, 14/22) matching antd Form's explain line. No separate DS V3 frame.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

selfCheck.label: input aria-describedby resolves to the error id

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The [data-probe] is the form-variant error under a DS <aha-input status="error">: the input's REAL inner field must be aria-invalid and described by the error element. Siblings assert the empty and respondent states.

expect.text: Enter an email address, like name@example.com
